summary: Blink Charging filed an 8-K updating its previously reported June 5, 2026 divestiture of Envoy Technologies (EV car-sharing) to BladeRanger Ltd. for $1.0M cash plus a $12.5M convertible note, part of refocusing on core charging. On October 9, 2026, BladeRanger sold Envoy to CID HoldCo; the note was amended to convert into 2,166,667 CID shares subject to Nasdaq stockholder approvals (Rules 5635(a),(b),(d)) and an effective Form S-1, with Blink intending a pro rata in-kind distribution to holders. Conversion shares carry a lock-up through the earlier of April 1, 2027 or six months post-conversion, excluding the distribution. Watch approval timing, S-1 effectiveness and CID share overhang.
